description_en: Queries the running status of a data synchronization task. This is a legacy API operation
description_zh: 老版查询同步作业的运行状态
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-synchronization-job-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtsexjk1alb1160000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSynchronizationJobStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the data synchronization instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html接口查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward. The value Reverse takes effect only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，本参数传入Reverse才会生效
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id
